errors.quote: Over $\mathbb F_2,$ norm-one tensors of indicators or coordinate units give each nonzero residual an orthonormal basis
errors.problem: This reads as if the orthonormal basis is made of such tensors. In the paper, these vectors only show that each nonzero (nondegenerate) residual contains a norm-one vector, so it is nonalternating. The orthonormal basis then comes from the general theorem that a nondegenerate nonalternating binary symmetric space has one (split off unit lines, absorb alternating planes with w+a, w+b, w+a+b).

The gate table reuses $t_T$, but there $T$ must be the gate's own physical triple. The paper says 'for a gate indexed by a physical bank triple, $t$ denotes that triple's indicator'. A side wire passes gates of two different triples ($Y$-triple at times 0 and 5, $X$-triple at times 2 and 7), so 'the wire's triple' does not determine its labels; the page then switches to $S,T$ for the 2-to-5 edge.
The sign is unspecified. The paper has $+$ when $V=U\perp E$ (an increasing edge) and the right side negated on a decreasing edge, where $E$ is the residual inside $U$.
